title: Oklahoma hunting licenses and controlled hunts
intro: A hunting license is required to hunt in Oklahoma. Controlled hunts (deer, elk, antelope, turkey) are a separate application with preference points. Confirm fees at Go Outdoors Oklahoma before you buy.

whereToBuy.title: Go Outdoors Oklahoma
whereToBuy.body: Buy licenses and apply for controlled hunts at https://gooutdoorsoklahoma.com/.

whereToBuy.title: License vendor
whereToBuy.body: Authorized vendors sell hunting licenses statewide.

whereToBuy.title: Controlled hunt draw
whereToBuy.body: Limited public hunts on WMAs and some Corps lands use the controlled-hunt application and preference points.

whereToBuy.title: Over the counter / open WMA
whereToBuy.body: Many WMA seasons are open under statewide seasons with area-specific restrictions — no draw required.

whereToBuy.title: Corps of Engineers lakes
whereToBuy.body: Tulsa District lakes open large acreages to public hunting under ODWC seasons; some hunts are controlled.

deadlines.name: Controlled hunt application
deadlines.detail: Windows vary by species — check ODWC controlled hunts each year.

deadlines.name: Archery deer (typical)
deadlines.detail: Statewide archery deer often opens Oct 1 — confirm the current regs.

preferencePoints: Oklahoma controlled hunts use preference points for many deer, elk, antelope, and turkey hunts.
Points are tracked in your Go Outdoors Oklahoma account.
